decision: Give an empty-evidence trust finding its own Class C debt kind (trust_evidence_gap) and a bounded evidence-discovery routine, replacing the interim laneEligible:false marker on trust_calibration_drift?
whyItMatters: Founder ruling 2026-10-28 (#2201): missing evidence is not evidence of degradation. The interim fix keeps these findings as Class B trust_calibration_drift debt that the lane never dispatches, so their authority label (B) misdescribes a governed question and no routine searches for the missing evidence.
evidence: 37 of 51 open trust_calibration_drift debts proposed 2-star to 1-star solely from an empty or non-scoring effective pool (13 have inherited rows that score nothing, 24 have no effective rows at all).
The 2026-10-28 run's builder reproduced addy-osmani/browser-testing-with-devtools but changed nothing and the Sonnet verifier escalated it; two lane entries had escalated.
A new kind needs authority and priority entries in founder/steward/POLICY.yaml and a founder rule; Steward may not add them itself.
recommended: Approve trust_evidence_gap as Class C with a founder rule, and a read-only evidence-discovery routine (authoritative upstream, releases, benchmarks, peer review; record URLs, dates, attribution, freshness, duplicates, admissibility) that never writes evidence or ratings; keep the interim marker until then.
alternative: Keep the interim marker and run evidence discovery as an ad hoc /ev-discovery pass per skill.
unblocks: One grouped desk decision for all evidence-gap skills instead of 37 Class B items, and a reusable discovery workflow.
